title: البنك المركزي الأردني يطلق خارطة الطريق القطاعية للانتقال إلى التشفير المقاوم للحوسبة الكمية (Quantum Computing)
summary: Central Bank of Jordan announcement that it has issued a sectoral roadmap for the financial and banking sectors to transition to encryption resistant to quantum computing, taking a phased approach to building technical and organisational readiness in line with international best practice. The roadmap itself is obtainable on request from the CBJ FinCERT by email.

title: 2025-2028 Jordan Energy Sector Cyber Security Strategy
summary: Sector cyber security strategy for Jordan's energy sector covering 2025 to 2028 (dated March 2025), led by NCSC-JO with EMRC overseeing implementation and MEMR ensuring policy alignment. It names quantum computing as an emerging threat to traditional encryption and calls for proactive investment in quantum-resistant encryption.
